title: Anisotropic-shell 2D Hexagonal Lattice Phonon Dispersion and Thermodynamics
summary: Construct a two-sublattice honeycomb dynamical matrix with first, second, and third neighbor springs, validate it in 1D, integrate a triangulated phonon DOS, and compute thermodynamics.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and input/model_config.json. Implement the specified dynamical matrix and staged numerical workflow without phonon/materials-science frameworks. Write diatomic_1d.npz, dispersion_2d.npz, dos.npz, thermodynamics.npz, results.json, and a self-contained solver.py directly under output/. The evaluator runs solver.py against an evaluator-only configuration, so derive outputs from the configuration rather than copying visible arrays. Use no network and do not modify input/.
agentMustDo: Read the geometry, force-constant convention, grids, units, and exact schemas from input/problem_spec.md.
Construct and diagonalize the 4x4 Hermitian dynamical matrix and perform the 1D validation, path dispersion, triangle DOS, and thermodynamic integration.
Produce all six required output files, including an executable solver.py, with finite arrays, exact keys, and documented units.
Make solver.py self-contained so the hidden configuration probe can execute it without imports outside output/.

inputFiles.name: problem_spec.md
inputFiles.description: Benchmark-authored scientific specification and output contract.

inputFiles.name: model_config.json
inputFiles.description: Visible parameter instance; the evaluator uses a hidden mass/spring mutation.

referenceFiles.name: diatomic_1d.npz
referenceFiles.description: Visible reference generated by the independent oracle.

evaluation: Missing, malformed, oversized, or out-of-contract output receives 0. A complete schema gate runs before any component scoring: exact archive keys/shapes, finite numeric arrays, exact JSON keys, numeric scalar types, and true integer types for all count/grid fields are required; malformed or missing one required thermodynamics key zeroes the whole score. The weighted components are tier1 0.20, tier2 path 0.25, DOS 0.20, thermodynamics 0.20, summary/invariant schema 0.05, and hidden solver probe 0.10. The hidden evaluator samples m2=chain_m2 and k3 in governed ranges, records the sampled config in evaluator-only results, invokes only output/solver.py in the guest, pulls its artifacts to the host, and independently recomputes/scorers references after solver termination. Evaluator source, oracle, and references are never staged beside the candidate; visible copying therefore cannot satisfy the hidden prerequisite. The hidden probe must regenerate every artifact within 80 seconds.
